text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mmh... I was so close, though...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I just didn't have enough fighting 
spirit to guarantee a win...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The grit that the bitter cold of Tomakomai 
nurtured in me... I must show it next 
time.
choice_data_list: I think that was a good run.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
! ...You're right. It certainly wasn't all 
bad.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Perhaps reflection is exactly what 
I need right now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The parts you struggled with are precisely 
where hints for improvement lie hidden!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just like a surf clam, I'll show you I can 
grow bigger and better!
